citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany the APHIS Official during the inspection process at 1:45pm on
Tuesday, June 16, 2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee but arrived at the facility to find it no longer in
business. The inspector then called the phone number provided for the licensee and they confirmed the business closed
approximately a year ago. Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the
AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
End Section
